rationale.usefulness: First positive egregore result with a measured timescale (~3 weeks; joint with H82 16-21 d). Round 2 removes the obvious levers: the mode is not in the artifact record, operator messages or outside-world talk, so curating artifacts or rewording operator messages will not steer it. Operators should compare a village with its last 2-3 weeks. Leverage stays limited until the carrier (rolling chat window or calendar drift) is found.
